title: Local search dialog: a combobox over the page's own list
intent: Search and filter a long page without leaving it
summary: A catalogue of 48 synthetic release notes rendered as a real list (every title, summary and tag in the served HTML) and indexed once from the DOM; a header button plus `/` and Ctrl/Cmd+K (ignored inside text fields) open a native `<dialog>` with `showModal()` whose `role="combobox"` input controls a `listbox`: every query word must start a word of the note's title, section, tags or summary (case and accents folded), title matches rank before tag matches before summary matches, matched word starts are wrapped in `<mark>` built as nodes, six section toggles (`aria-pressed`) narrow the set, a narrowed list makes its first option active, arrows move `aria-activedescendant` with wrap-around, Enter or a click closes the dialog, pushes the hash, scrolls the note under the sticky bar, focuses its heading and tints it for `1.6 s`; Escape (the `cancel` event, faded out over `80 ms`) returns focus to whatever opened it; the count is visible as `n of 48` and announced in a polite status `450 ms` after the last change; an empty result collapses the combobox (`aria-expanded="false"`) and offers Clear filters; new results arrive on the feedback band (`160 ms`, opacity plus a 4 px rise); the dialog opens with a `240 ms` fade and 12 px rise in the full tier, a `160 ms` fade under reduced motion and a cut in the static tier; a full-screen sheet on phones
variants: a dialog over a release's notes, section toggles (this, default)
an inline combobox in the header that expands into the same listbox, for a page with fewer than about twenty items
a version switcher beside it: a native `<select>` of editions whose change navigates, with the search scoped to the edition shown
